threat_event: Leaked long-lived CI/CD cloud access key is used to read payroll export files and copy database snapshots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Static access keys in CI secrets (2 older than 1 year) with broad write and read permissions; no alerting on unusual cloud API activity
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03; SYS-01 object storage and database snapshots
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(a); 45(n) unfairness); Customer DPA (contract) (72-hour notice)
existing_controls: MFA on CI service; branch protection; keys stored as encrypted CI secrets
treatment_plan: Replace static keys with short-lived federated workload credentials scoped per pipeline; alert on API calls from unknown networks and bulk object reads; secret scanning on all repositories

threat_event: Shared break-glass database role is misused (by an insider or with a stolen vault entry) to read or change customer data without attribution
threat_source: Insider or external attacker with a stolen credential
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared role used by 6 engineers for routine fixes; no session recording; attribution only through vault checkout log
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(a); 45(n) unfairness); SOC 2 Type 1 exception 1 (CC6.1; CC6.3)
existing_controls: Hardware security keys for vault and console; vault checkout log
treatment_plan: Named just-in-time access with approval and 1-hour expiry; session recording for database sessions; weekly review of privileged sessions

threat_event: Customer worker data copied to staging is exposed through staging's weaker controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Staging refreshed monthly from an unmasked production snapshot; all 21 engineers have write access; debug features enabled
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(a); 45(n) unfairness); SOC 2 Type 1 exception 2 (C1.1)
existing_controls: Staging behind single sign-on with MFA
treatment_plan: Stop production refreshes; purge existing copies; generate synthetic or masked test data; protect staging at production level until purge is confirmed

threat_event: A sub-processor (logging, SMS, email, support, or model provider) is breached and exposes customer worker data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security review before onboarding; no annual review of sub-processor SOC 2 reports; contract security terms vary
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(a); 45(n) unfairness); Customer DPA (contract); SOC 2 Type 1 exception 3 (CC9.2)
existing_controls: DPAs signed with 5 of 6 sub-processors; public sub-processor list
treatment_plan: Sub-processor risk process: tiering, pre-onboarding review, annual SOC 2 review with CUEC mapping (P09)

threat_event: Authorization flaw lets one customer's users see another customer's worker data (cross-tenant exposure)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tenant isolation enforced only in application code; automated isolation tests cover 80% of API endpoints
existing_controls: Tenant-scoped data access layer; annual penetration test; code review
treatment_plan: Extend isolation tests to 100% of endpoints and make them a merge gate; add database-level row security as a second layer

threat_event: Outage of the primary cloud region stops time capture and scheduling beyond the RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No DR plan; no regional failover test; last restore took 5 hours
existing_controls: Snapshots copied to a second region; infrastructure as code
treatment_plan: DR plan with a documented regional recovery runbook; semiannual restore and failover tests

threat_event: Attacker with administrator access deletes the production database and its snapshots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Snapshots and cross-region copies are in the same account and can be deleted by the same roles
existing_controls: Point-in-time recovery; MFA on console
treatment_plan: Copy snapshots to a separate backup account with write-once retention and separate credentials

threat_event: Support agent uses view-as-tenant to browse or change worker data without a support need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Any of 10 agents can open any tenant; no customer approval; sessions not reviewed
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(a); deception); Customer DPA (contract) (use limited to providing the service)
existing_controls: Admin console behind SSO and MFA; audit events recorded
treatment_plan: Ticket-linked, customer-approved, time-limited access; monthly review of sessions

threat_event: Customer notice after an incident misses the 72-hour (or 48-hour) contract deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Incident plan never tested; notice step not aligned to contract terms; no customer contact list for security notices
regulatory_driver: Customer DPA (contract); Fla. Stat. 501.171(6) (third-party agent notice)
existing_controls: Incident response plan (Type 1)
treatment_plan: Update plan and runbook (P08); security contact list per customer; tabletop exercise

threat_event: Public security statements are shown to be inaccurate after an incident or complaint
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Security page says every access is logged, which is false for the break-glass role; no review of claims against practice
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Quarterly review of public statements and questionnaire library by IT Manager and COO; correct the security page now

threat_event: Data of terminated customers is exposed or found retained past the 90-day deletion commitment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No automated tenant deletion; 14 former customers' tenants still present
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(a); deception); Customer DPA (contract) (90-day deletion)
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Delete the 14 tenants after contract check; automated deletion job with evidence

threat_event: Engineer laptop infected with information-stealing malware leaks session tokens for the repository or cloud console
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Long-lived browser sessions; engineers install developer tools freely
existing_controls: EDR; hardware security keys; device management
treatment_plan: Shorter session lifetimes for admin apps; device-bound sessions where supported

threat_event: Known vulnerability in a container image or library is exploited in production
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Image scanning not enforced; no remediation timelines
existing_controls: Dependency scanning in CI; annual penetration test
treatment_plan: Block deploys with Critical findings; remediation timelines (Critical 7 days, High 30 days); monthly report

threat_event: Malicious or compromised build dependency or CI action injects code into a production release
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Third-party CI actions referenced by tag, not pinned; no build provenance
existing_controls: Dependency scanning; code review
treatment_plan: Pin CI actions and base images by digest; restrict CI permissions; sign release images

threat_event: Former contractor uses a non-SSO repository account to access source code and CI secrets
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two local repository accounts outside single sign-on survived offboarding (found in P07 testing)
existing_controls: Repository requires MFA for all members
treatment_plan: Remove accounts (done 2026-09-04); enforce SSO-only membership; add repository to quarterly access review

threat_event: Lost or altered time punches corrupt a payroll export and customers pay workers incorrectly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payroll export logic changed often; no reconciliation check between punches and exports
existing_controls: Unit tests; customer approval of timesheets before export
treatment_plan: Export reconciliation totals shown to the customer before approval; regression suite for pay rules

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over worker accounts and changes contact details or swaps shifts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA optional for workers; rate limiting only
existing_controls: Rate limiting; salted and hashed passwords
treatment_plan: Breached-password screening; step-up verification for contact-detail changes; bot detection

threat_event: Worker personal data in application logs is exposed through the logging SaaS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Some error messages log names and phone numbers
existing_controls: 30-day retention; SSO on logging SaaS
treatment_plan: Log redaction library; scan logs for personal data patterns

threat_event: AI assistant sends customer data to the model provider beyond what the DPA and public statements allow, or the provider retains it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model provider added without formal review and with 12 days' notice instead of 30; public data-use statement not updated
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(a); deception); Customer DPA (contract) (30-day sub-processor notice)
existing_controls: Provider's API terms exclude training on inputs by default
treatment_plan: Confirm zero-retention setting in writing; re-notify customers; update data-use statement; customer opt-out switch (see P10)

threat_event: Shift-swap suggestions systematically offer fewer shifts to workers in a protected group
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No bias testing; model sees worker names; reliability score may penalize recurring unavailability
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(a); 45(n) unfairness); customer employment-law duties (see P10)
existing_controls: Manager approves every swap
treatment_plan: Remove names from prompts; counterfactual and impact-ratio testing before general availability (see P10)

threat_event: AI schedule summary misstates a worker's shifts so the worker misses a shift
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Generative summaries are not checked against schedule data
existing_controls: Summary labeled as AI-generated; full schedule one tap away
treatment_plan: Automated consistency check against structured schedule data before display

threat_event: Prompt injection in free-text shift notes causes the AI assistant to reveal data outside the requester's scope
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Free-text notes passed to the model
existing_controls: Model receives only the requesting tenant's data
treatment_plan: Pass only data the requesting user may see; input filtering; red-team tests

threat_event: Distributed denial of service during shift-change peaks blocks clock-ins
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single region; rate limits tuned for normal load
existing_controls: Provider DDoS protection and web application firewall; mobile app queues punches offline
treatment_plan: Accepted by CTO: residual risk Low; revisit if SLA credits exceed $10,000 in a quarter

threat_event: Identity provider administrator account is taken over, giving access to every connected system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 identity provider super-administrators; no alert on admin changes
existing_controls: Hardware keys for admins
treatment_plan: Reduce to 2 super-administrators; alert on admin role and policy changes

threat_event: Lost or stolen laptop exposes cached customer data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops travel with sales and support staff
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe; EDR
treatment_plan: Accepted by IT Manager: residual risk Low

threat_event: SOC 2 Type 2 report has exceptions or a modified opinion, delaying renewals and new deals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Type 1 exceptions not yet closed; Availability new to scope; controls must operate for 6 months
existing_controls: Type 1 report; readiness assessment (P09)
treatment_plan: Close readiness gates before 2026-11-01; monthly evidence checks (P09)

threat_event: A customer audit finds CCPA service-provider terms are not followed (for example, data used outside the contract)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No internal check that data uses match service-provider terms
existing_controls: DPA with CCPA service-provider terms
treatment_plan: Data-use register reviewed by the privacy lead before new features ship

threat_event: Only the Platform Engineering Lead knows how to rebuild production, so recovery stalls if unavailable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recovery steps undocumented
existing_controls: Infrastructure as code
treatment_plan: Written recovery runbook; second engineer runs the semiannual restore test

threat_event: SMS provider outage delays shift reminders and swap requests
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SMS provider
existing_controls: Email and push notifications continue
treatment_plan: Accepted by IT Manager: residual risk Low

threat_event: Third-party API keys (SMS, email, model provider) committed to source code are harvested
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No secret scanning on push; keys not rotated
existing_controls: Private repositories
treatment_plan: Push protection for secrets; rotate all third-party keys; move keys to the secrets manager

threat_event: An incident cannot be scoped because cloud and application logs have expired or were never collected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 90-day default cloud log retention; not exported; 30-day application logs; no object-level access logs on the payroll export bucket
existing_controls: Default provider logging
treatment_plan: Export cloud audit logs and object access logs to a separate log account with 1-year retention; weekly review

threat_event: Terminated employee keeps access to a corporate SaaS app not connected to single sign-on
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 corporate SaaS apps not federated; manual removal
existing_controls: Same-day identity provider disable; termination checklist
treatment_plan: Federate the 4 apps or add them to the termination checklist with evidence

threat_event: Object storage bucket holding payroll exports is made public by a configuration change
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bucket policies managed partly by hand
existing_controls: Account-level public access block; infrastructure as code for most buckets
treatment_plan: Bring all buckets under infrastructure as code; configuration monitoring alert

threat_event: A vendor with access from a country of concern creates a prohibited or restricted data transaction
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor due diligence does not ask about access from countries of concern
existing_controls: No offshore staff or hosting; all sub-processors U.S.-based
treatment_plan: Add a DOJ Data Security Program question to the sub-processor review
